{

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Fill a rectangular 3-frame interior with 4, drawing concentric square rings of 2 around its interior 3 marker."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    markers = [(r, c) for r, c in points if r0 < r < r1 and c0 < c < c1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            d = max(abs(r - markers[0][0]), abs(c - markers[0][1]))
            out[r][c] = 2 if d > 0 and d % 2 == 0 else 4
    for r, c in markers:
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
"
}
